positions.statement: Susan Baker (Burlingame Chamber of Commerce, CEO) signed the argument in favor of Burlingame School District Measure R in the San Mateo County measure documents (resolutions, impartial analyses, arguments as filed), November 3, 2026 General Election voter guide.
